title: Qt: Rework splash overlay for direct updates and extcap progress
description:
Simplify the splash update path by routing splash_update() directly to
SplashOverlay via a static instance pointer instead of bouncing through
MainApplication's signal/slot chain. Use repaint() for synchronous
painting so the displayed message always matches the current action.

Add per-extcap progress reporting during startup by extending
extcap_register_preferences() with an optional register_cb callback.
Worker threads push completed extcap paths to a queue which the main
thread drains to update the splash overlay. CLI tools pass NULL and
are unaffected.

Split the splash card into a bold title line and a dimmer subtext line
underneath for detail messages (extcap paths, dissector names). Extract
layout magic numbers into named constants.

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude)

notes.body: For those interested in the motivation for this change. I've noticed that at startup the splash overlay got stuck always on a different message so I've investigated. I've added the output for the extcap parsing, so that issues with slow or unresponsive parsing of extcap files that may delay startup can be investigated.
